author: rdc-rfc1-author-a (Claude Haiku 5.5)
rationale: Each clock domain releases its registers through its own two-stage synchroniser from por_n, and no data crosses between the domains.

author_reading.rationale: Each domain's reset is released by a two-stage synchroniser clocked by that domain, and the functional flops use the synchronised release.

labels.rationale: Each domain has its own 2-stage reset synchroniser (rst_a, rst_b) from por_n, and each q is reset by the last stage of its own domain. There is no data crossing, since beat_a and beat_b feed their own domains.
Each domain asserts asynchronously and releases through its own two-stage chain. No data dependency requires a relative release order.
